BillIn.description: A bill; its total is the sum of its lines.
BillIn.title: BillIn

CitationOut.description: A passage an answer rests on, and its page where the document has pages.
CitationOut.title: CitationOut

DocumentMatch.description: A document found by a search, with the text around the first match.
DocumentMatch.title: DocumentMatch

Health.description: The application's state as the health check sees it.
Health.title: Health

LineIn.description:
A line of a bill. ``id`` names an existing line, whose split is kept if nothing that
decides it (the category, the amount, the bill's date) has changed.
LineIn.title: LineIn

Me.description: The person logged in, with what the interface needs to know about the app.
Me.title: Me

MeUpdate.description:
A person's change to themselves. A new password needs the current one; notification
settings left out stay as they are.
MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate

PasskeyIn.description: A passkey to add: the authenticator's answer, as the browser serialises it.
PasskeyIn.title: PasskeyIn

PersonDetail.description:
A person with their contacts, which only an admin and the person themselves see; None
for anyone else. The audit log records the plain ``PersonOut``, without them.
PersonDetail.title: PersonDetail

PersonUpdate.description: An admin's change to someone; a password given here resets theirs.
PersonUpdate.title: PersonUpdate

Proposal.description:
A bill as read from its file, to be checked and corrected before it is saved.

``sources`` says where each value came from: "qr" for the invoice's fiscal QR code, "text" for
the PDF's own text, "ocr" for text read from the image of a page, "claude" for what Claude
read where the others found nothing.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ReadingIn.description: A quantity the bill measures, and its unit price in euros before tax.
ReadingIn.title: ReadingIn

ReadingPoint.description: One bill's reading, for a consumption chart.
ReadingPoint.title: ReadingPoint

ReconciliationLine.description: One household's position over a reconciliation's period.
ReconciliationLine.title: ReconciliationLine

ServiceChanges.description: What the bill says about its service's contract that differs from what is on file.
ServiceChanges.title: ServiceChanges

SettingsIn.description: A change to the app's settings; a setting left out stays as it is.
SettingsIn.title: SettingsIn

SetupIn.description: The first administrator and their household.
SetupIn.title: SetupIn

SetupState.description:
What the page needs before anyone logs in: whether setup is due, and the app's name, or
None for the interface's own.
SetupState.title: SetupState

SplitPreview.description: How an amount in a category would be split on a date, and by which rule.
SplitPreview.title: SplitPreview

Summary.description: A year's costs by category and by month, with each household's share.
Summary.title: Summary

Terms.description: A contract's terms as Claude read them, for a person to check before using any.
Terms.title: Terms

info.summary: A shared house's running costs, split between households
info.title: House costs

post.description: Attach a PDF or a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) to a bill or a settlement.

delete.description: Detach a file. Its bytes stay on disk, so the audit log's record of it still points at it.

get.description:
The attached file itself, shown in the browser where it can be.

Served with a sandboxing content security policy and no type sniffing, so even a file that
slipped past the type check cannot run script in the app's origin.
Who changed what, newest first; open to everyone, so every change is visible to all.

post.description:
Log in with a login and password.

A wrong password and an unknown login are refused alike, and take as long, so the answer
does not reveal which logins exist. Too many failures from one address are refused with 429
for a minute.
End this browser's session, if it has one.

get.description: The person logged in.

patch.description:
Change one's own name, language or password.

A new password needs the current one, and ends every other session of this person.

post.description: Send a test notification to this person's own email address and phone.

Finish logging in with a passkey, and start a session as its owner.

Every refusal counts against the address's failed logins, as a wrong password does.

Start logging in with a passkey. Names nobody: the authenticator offers whichever of its
passkeys belong to this site.

schema.title: Response Login Options Api Auth Passkey Login Options Post

get.description: The passkeys on this person's account.

schema.title: Response List Passkeys Api Auth Passkeys Get

post.description: Finish adding a passkey, from the authenticator's answer to the challenge.

Start adding a passkey: the options a browser hands its authenticator.

The passkey is discoverable, so it can log in without a login typed first, and the
authenticator is told which of this person's passkeys it already holds.

schema.title: Response Registration Options Api Auth Passkeys Options Post

delete.description: Remove one of this person's passkeys; it can no longer log in.

get.description: Every browser this person is logged in on, most recently used first.

schema.title: Response Sessions Api Auth Sessions Get

delete.description: Log one of this person's other browsers out.

get.description: Every household's balance, and the transfers that would settle them.
Bills not deleted, newest first, optionally narrowed by year, category, payer or text.

post.description:
Enter a bill. Each line is split by its category's rule in force on the bill's date.

Once it is saved, the other households hear of it, and everyone of a price it changed.

Read a bill's PDF or photo into a proposed bill, which nothing saves until a person has
checked it. The file is not kept; it is attached when the bill is saved.

delete.description: Delete a bill. It is only marked, and stays in the audit log.

get.description: One bill, with its lines, their shares and its attachments.

put.description: Correct a bill. Lines whose category, amount and date are unchanged keep their split.

get.description: Every category, by name.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api Categories Get

post.description: Add a category. Nothing can be filed under it until it has a rule.

put.description: Rename, describe or deactivate a category.

get.description:
Documents newest first, narrowed by kind, supplier, service, and words in their title,
notes, file name or text.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Documents Get

post.description: Keep a PDF or a photo in the library; a PDF's text is read so it can be searched.

delete.description: Remove a document from the library. Its bytes stay on disk, as an attachment's do.

get.description: One document's details.

put.description: Change a document's title, kind, date, links or notes.

post.description: An answer from the document to a question, with the passages and pages it rests on.

get.description:
The document's file, shown in the browser where it can be, under the same sandbox as an
attachment.

post.description:
A contract's dates, lock-in, notice and a summary, as Claude reads them. Nothing is saved:
the interface offers the dates for the document's service.

get.description:
Report that the process is up and its database answers.

Unauthenticated, and it queries the database rather than returning a constant: a container
that answers while its database cannot be opened is not healthy.
Every household, in their configured order.

schema.title: Response List Households Api Households Get

post.description: Add a household. It owes nothing until a rule gives it a share.

put.description: Rename, reorder or deactivate a household. Its history stays as it is.

get.description: Everyone who can log in, by name.

schema.title: Response List People Api People Get

post.description: Give someone a login, with a first password they can change themselves.

put.description:
Change someone's details, role or household, deactivate them, or reset their password.

The last active admin cannot be demoted or deactivated, so the app always has one. A reset
password or a deactivation ends the person's sessions.

get.description: Every reading of bills not deleted, oldest first, optionally for one service.
Every reconciliation, latest period first.

schema.title: Response List Reconciliations Api Reconciliations Get

post.description: Start a draft reconciliation of a period.

delete.description: Discard a draft. A closed reconciliation is final.

get.description: One reconciliation with each household's position; a draft's is worked out afresh.

put.description: Change a draft's period, note or reconciled shares.

post.description: Close a draft: write each household's adjustment and lock the period's bills.

get.description: Every bill line of a year (or of all years), one row each, with each household's share.

A year's costs by category and by month, each with every household's share.

Without a year, the latest year that has bills, or this one.
Every rule, or one category's, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Rules Api Rules Get

post.description: Add a rule for a category from a date. Bills already split keep their split.

delete.description: Remove a rule entered by mistake; one that has split a bill cannot be removed.

get.description: Every service, by supplier and name.

schema.title: Response List Services Api Services Get

post.description: Add a service, with what its contract says.

put.description: Correct a service, or mark it ended by deactivating it.

get.description: The app's settings.

put.description: Change the app's settings; those left out keep their value.

get.description: Settlements not deleted, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Settlements Api Settlements Get

post.description: Record a transfer between two households.

delete.description: Delete a recorded transfer. It is only marked, and stays in the audit log.

get.description: Whether the app still needs setting up, and the name it goes by.

post.description: Create the first household and its administrator, and log them in.

get.description: How an amount in a category would be split on a date: what a bill line would get.
Every supplier, by name.

schema.title: Response List Suppliers Api Suppliers Get

post.description: Add a supplier. Its tax number, when given, must be its own.
